name: Comments
description: A conversation on the instance: messages, each top-level or a reply in the thread of a top-level one, one level deep, which their authors edit and delete, others react to and pin, and whose threads are resolved and reopened. Every operation is beside the instance: it writes Comments' own tables, never moves the instance's seq, ETag or updatedAt, and runs none of its guards, so a lease on the instance does not stop a reply. A caller who may read the instance reads the conversation; the policy is asked write for a writing operation, post included. Deleting the instance deletes its conversation.

maxBodyLength.description: The longest body a post or an edit may give, in code points; 40000 when absent.

editWindowMs.description: How long after posting its author may edit a message, in milliseconds; no limit when absent. A caller holding moderatePermission is not held to it.

blocks.description: The block kinds a post or an edit may give; every kind when absent, none when empty.

moderatePermission.description: The permission that lets a caller edit and delete another's message, edit past editWindowMs, and purge. Absent, only a message's author edits or deletes it, and nobody purges.

pinPermission.description: The permission a caller needs to pin and unpin. Absent, any caller the policy lets write may.

resolvePermission.description: The permission that lets a caller resolve and reopen another's thread. Absent, only a thread's author does.

fields.name: messages
fields.description: How many posted messages the conversation has, top-level and replies; deleted and purged ones are not counted.

fields.name: lastMessageAt
fields.description: When the latest posted message was posted, in epoch milliseconds; absent while there is none.

fields.name: threads
fields.description: The posted top-level messages, each a thread, whether resolved or not: { open, resolved }.

operations.name: post
operations.description: Posts a message as the caller: top-level, or a reply in the thread of a top-level message, which may quote a message of that thread. A ref block's instance must be one the caller may read, and each block's kind one the config allows. A retry with the clientId of a message the caller posted returns that message and posts nothing.

body.description: The text, Markdown, at most the config's maxBodyLength code points.

blocks.description: Structured parts beside the body, each of a kind the config allows.

items.description: A block, checked against its kind.

oneOf.description: Another instance of the namespace, which the poster must be able to read when the block is posted; a reader's own read decides whether it opens.
A card for something the poster did, "ran the tests" say; an edit moves its status.

data.description: What a client shows with it, at most 8192 bytes as compact JSON.

mentions.description: The subjects the message names for someone to hear of it: a person's, an agent's or a group's (role:<name>), as the client resolved them from what was typed.

thread.description: The id of the top-level message to reply in; a top-level message when absent.

quotes.description: The id of the message of the thread the reply quotes, the top-level one or a reply; needs thread.

clientId.description: The caller's key for the message, so a retry returns the message it posted.

id.description: The message's number on the instance: 1, 2, 3, ...; never reused.

thread.description: For a reply, the id of the top-level message whose thread it is in; absent on a top-level message.

quotes.description: The id of the message of the thread the reply quotes.

author.description: The subject of the caller who posted it.

via.description: The deployable of the service whose call posted it (D37).

operations.name: edit
operations.description: Replaces a posted message's body, blocks or mentions, keeping what it held before for listEdits. Its author may, within the config's editWindowMs of posting when it sets one; a caller holding moderatePermission may edit any message, at any time. A ref block not on the message before must name an instance the caller may read.

operations.name: listMessages
operations.description: Lists a page of the conversation's top-level messages, or with thread a page of that thread's replies, deleted ones included, in ascending id order: the latest page when no anchor is given, the page before or after a message id, or the page around a message of the listing. Each page says where the next older and newer ones start.

thread.description: The id of a top-level message: the page is its thread's replies, and the result carries the message as root.

around.description: A message of the listing: the page holds it and the messages either side of it. At most one of around, before and after.

before.description: The page is the latest messages with a lower id.

after.description: The page is the earliest messages with a higher id.

limit.description: At most this many messages; 50 when absent.

An edit, delete, reaction, pin, resolve or reopen of a deleted message, or a post quoting one. details: message.
An edit or delete of another's message, or a resolve or reopen of another's thread, by a caller without moderatePermission (resolvePermission for a thread). details: message, author.
An edit by the message's author more than the config's editWindowMs after it was posted. details: message, createdAt, editWindowMs.
An edit of a message that has been edited 500 times. details: message, max.
react with an emoji the caller has already given the message. details: message, emoji.
unreact of an emoji the caller has not given the message. details: message, emoji.
react with a 21st distinct emoji on a message. details: message, max.
pin of a pinned message. details: message.
unpin of a message that is not pinned. details: message.
resolve of a resolved thread. details: thread, by, at.
reopen of a thread that is not resolved. details: thread.
A block of a kind the config's blocks does not list. details: block, its index in blocks; kind; allowed.
A ref block whose instance does not exist or the caller may not read, the same refusal for both. details: block, schema, id.
purge on a type whose config names no moderatePermission. details: permission, "moderatePermission".
